curated-fs-kalam-gf-stoke: Kalam, hand-drawn and cozy, might letter a woodworking shop sign. Kalam does bundled handwriting best, while Stoke, a text serif, handles bookish, watercolor-soft weight shifts, though not long paragraphs.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-tiro-devanagari-sans: Cozy handwriting up top, with a refined and authoritative serif below. Kalam's tightly bundled lines sit against the bold stems and wire-thin horizontals of Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit, so skip long paragraphs.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-tiro-kannada: Cozy and hand-drawn, Kalam leads over a refined Tiro Kannada serif, maybe for a yoga logo. Swollen curves against hairline joins: that tension is the draw, in modest portions.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-vollkorn: Kalam feels cozy and hand-drawn, say, for a sticker shop. Vollkorn, a text serif, adds a literary, faintly modulated line beneath, with lighter horizontals, though long paragraphs aren't its job.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-zen-antique: Zen Antique reads literary, with razor-thin serifs on dense pillars. Kalam does cozy handwriting best (a tech startup wordmark, say), while Zen Antique does steel-nib swell and hairline for quick reading.
curated-fs-khand-gf-abhaya-libre: Abhaya Libre cranks up its stroke contrast; Khand, crisp, has none. Abhaya Libre, with open-faced curves and nib-like fat stems, gives long stretches of text an editorial, dignified pace.
curated-fs-khand-gf-alike-angular: Crisp from the first word, Khand draws every stroke with no contrast. Alike Angular, a text serif, adds a mid-range swing between its boldest and faintest strokes, keeping letters held open.
curated-fs-khand-gf-cardo: Cardo reads literary and dignified, say for a product requirements document. Across a full page of text, its softly varied strokes and outward-connected counters keep things moving, while Khand stays ruler-straight.
curated-fs-khand-gf-gupter: Gupter, a text serif, leaves a visible gap in every c, with tight tracking. Gupter handles gently tapered, glass-rod weight shifts, while Khand does flat, crisp lines best (a sticker sheet, say).
curated-fs-khand-gf-ibarra-real-nova: Ibarra Real Nova reads editorial, with fat strokes pulling hard against slender ones, unlike Khand's uniform lines. Ibarra Real Nova keeps longer text inviting, since its bowls stay unclosed.
